extDescription.message: Queue Spotify tracks, albums, artists and playlists in your spotdl-web app, straight from open.spotify.com.

iconTrackNamed.description: The icon's accessible name; TITLE is the track's name as Spotify shows it.

iconHint.message: Right-click, Shift+F10 or the Menu key for more choices
iconHint.description: Tooltip and description on the icon.

toastQueuedAlbum.message: The whole album is queued in spotdl

toastQueuedArtist.message: The whole artist is queued in spotdl

toastAlreadyQueued.message: Already in your queue: it's still downloading

toastInLibrary.message: Already in the library: nothing to download

errorLoginRequired.message: Log in to spotdl in this browser, or add an API key

errorKeyInvalid.message: spotdl refused the API key. Check it in the extension's settings

errorPermissionMissing.message: Let the extension reach $ORIGIN$ in its settings

errorNotAnApp.message: $ORIGIN$ doesn't answer like a spotdl app

errorRateLimited.message: Too many submissions. Try again in $SECONDS$ s

errorUrlNotSpotify.message: spotdl only takes Spotify track, album, artist and playlist links

errorCascadeUnavailable.message: Couldn't read Spotify's details for it. Try again

errorCascadeInvalid.message: That choice doesn't apply to this item

errorQueueUnavailable.message: spotdl's queue is unavailable. Try again shortly

optionsIntro.message: The download icon on open.spotify.com sends the item's link to your spotdl-web app. Nothing else leaves the browser, and nothing goes anywhere but the app below.

optionsAppHint.message: Default: $DEFAULT$. Plain http works only on this computer (localhost, 127.0.0.1).

optionsAppInvalid.message: That isn't an address the extension can use. Give an https address, or http on localhost.

optionsAppDenied.message: Firefox didn't grant access to $ORIGIN$, so the address wasn't saved.

optionsAppSaved.description: RESULT is one of the connection status sentences.

optionsAuthCookie.message: The extension uses your spotdl sign-in in this Firefox: log in to the app in any tab, and the icon just works.

optionsAuthKey.message: Where that sign-in doesn't reach (a private window, cookies cleared on close), give it an API key from the app's account page. It's kept in this browser only, never synced.

optionsKeyInvalid.message: A key starts with sdw_. Copy the whole key from the app's account page.

optionsKeySaved.description: END is the key's last 4 characters.

optionsKeyStored.description: END is the key's last 4 characters.

statusSignedIn.description: NAME is the username or email; VIA is viaCookie or viaKey.

viaCookie.message: through your sign-in in this browser

statusLoginRequired.message: Reached the app, but you aren't signed in. Log in to spotdl in this browser, or add an API key.

optionsSpotifyGranted.message: The extension may add its icon on open.spotify.com.

optionsSpotifyMissing.message: The extension isn't allowed on open.spotify.com yet, so no icon appears there.

popupEmpty.message: Nothing sent yet. Use the download icon on open.spotify.com.

toastPermissionMissing.message: Let the extension reach your spotdl app, in its settings

toastNotAnApp.message: The address in the settings doesn't answer like a spotdl app

optionsAppNotSaved.description: RESULT is one of the connection status sentences.

statusFailed.message: The app answered with an error. Try again

toastChooseArtistAgain.message: It has more than one artist: open the menu again to choose one

outcomeRateLimited.message: Too many submissions at the time

statusPermissionMissing.message: Firefox doesn't let the extension reach $ORIGIN$ yet: allow access below

errorServer.message: Your spotdl app had an error. Try again

optionsKeyNotSaved.description: RESULT is one of the connection status sentences.

toastStillSending.message: Your last choice for this is still on its way: wait for its answer

optionsKeyAddressChanged.message: the app address changed while the key was being checked. Save it again
